paired.label: Trim paired reads
paired.description: Trim the listed 3′ adapters and bases below quality 5. Discard pairs if either trimmed read is shorter than 20 bases.

single.label: Trim one read file
single.description: Trim the listed 3′ adapter and bases below quality 5 from the first read file. Discard trimmed reads shorter than 20 bases.

help.label: Show help
help.description: Show Cutadapt's command-line options. No input files are needed.

human.label: Human reads
human.description: A small set of real human read pairs recovered from a BAM file. These reads have already been processed; their retained quality scores allow quality-trimming comparisons.

yeast.label: Yeast reads
yeast.description: A small set of real yeast read pairs from raw FASTQ files, selected to include reads with adapter sequence. Results describe this selected subset.
